definition.per_level: mean over the 100 test episodes of a level of the probe prediction (log area ratio) at rollout step k; true = log nominal area ratio of the level; bias = mean_pred - true
definition.slope_episode|role: OLS slope of the episode-level prediction on the label over the episodes of the role (9 levels for 'all', 6 for 'unseen', 3 for 'trained')
definition.slope_levelmeans|role: OLS slope of the level means on the level labels
definition.probe_seed_handling: predictions are averaged over the probe seeds before the summary; max abs spread over seeds is reported
kinds: encoder (ceiling: same probe on encoder tokens of frame t+k)
rollout (same probe on the predicted latent of step k)

definition.r2: exp002 definition: 1 - SSE/SST on the pooled episodes of the role, SST about the role mean of the label (probe-seed mean of per-seed values)
definition.persistence: encoder tokens of the context frame t (t = num_hist - 1 = 0) copied to every step; the Q1 probe applied to the copy; label of step k = label of frame t+k
definition.ceiling: same probe on the encoder tokens of frame t+k
definition.untrained: predictor (and action/proprio encoders in variant pred_and_action_proprio) freshly initialised, see README section 3; DINOv2 input encoder is the original frozen one
definition.ci: episode-cluster bootstrap 95% (levels fixed), evaluation episodes only; excludes training-seed and untrained-seed variation

B.note_first_frame: num_hist = 1, so the last context frame is frame 0 = the first frame; both persistence definitions are the same set of predictions

definition.retrained: ridge probe (exp002 probes.linear_fit_predict) fitted on the patch-mean latent of rollout step k of the probe-training rows (a060, ind, a160: 900 rows, one sample per row) with the label of frame t+k; alpha/folds chosen inside those rows only; evaluated on the test rows' latent of the same step
definition.transfer: the Q1 probe fitted on encoder tokens only (002 output-space measurement) applied to the same latent
definition.encoder_retrained: same retraining on the encoder tokens of frame t+k (single-frame Q1 ceiling, cross-checked with 002 q1 cells f<k>)
definition.limitation_a: In condition (a) single_ind the predictor was trained on ind episodes only; its rollouts of the a060/a160 training rows (used here to train the probe) are rollouts of sizes it never saw. Condition (b) trained on all three probe-training sizes
definition.leak_rule: no test row is passed to the fit; alpha and folds are chosen by GroupKFold inside the training rows

definition.probe: Q1 linear probe path (exp002 probes.linear_fit_predict): fitted on encoder tokens (patch mean) of the probe-training rows, frames 0..11, label of the same frame; applied unchanged to encoder tokens of frame k, persistence (frame t copied) and the rollout latent of step k
definition.labels: mask_centroid / mask_bbox_center: cloth mask (002 HSV rule) of the cached 224x224 frame, coordinates / 224, frames with an empty mask are excluded from fit and evaluation; cum_action_*: sum of the raw actions with index < 5*frame for gripper 1 (dims dx1 dy1 dz1) and gripper 2 (dx2 dy2 dz2) = commanded displacement since frame 0 (NOT a measured gripper position; initial position not in the data fields read)
definition.r2: role pooled R2 (1 - SSE/SST); r2_within_level|all: R2 after removing level means of label and prediction (002 stats.r2_within_from_level_sums)

definition.ci95: mean +- t_{0.975, n-1} * sd / sqrt(n) with n = 3 training seeds, df = 2, t = 4.302653. Wide by construction; seeds are the unit, episodes are pooled inside each value
definition.drop: R2(encoder tokens, step k) - R2(rollout, step k), same probe, role-pooled (002 H_b drop uses role 'unseen' at the last step)
definition.a_minus_b: welch: diff of means with Welch-Satterthwaite t interval (no pairing); paired_by_seed_index: differences of seed s of (a) and seed s of (b), t interval df = n-1. Pairing by seed index is a convention only
definition.order_accuracy: exp002 stats.pair_order_accuracy: fraction of cross-level episode pairs whose predicted order equals the true level order; mean over probe seeds; point estimate

definition.teacher_forced: one-step prediction of frame t+k from the real encoder latent of frame t+k-1 (num_hist = 1: a single context frame; its action part is the real action embedding, the same one the open-loop rollout writes back each step; its proprio part is the real encoded proprio instead of the predicted one). Same checkpoint, same rows, same pooling (fp16 cast, float32 patch mean)

definition.labels: label of step k = log nominal area ratio of frame t+k (same for both latents)
definition.tf_minus_ol: teacher_forced minus open_loop of the same quantity, same run, same step
definition.seed_level: n = 3 training seeds per condition, sample SD (ddof 1), CI = mean +- t_{0.975, 2} * sd / sqrt(3). Episode bootstrap CI (unseen, trained) covers evaluation episodes only

limitations: Post hoc exploration: planned after the 002 results and reviews were read (hypotheses.md candidate J). Not confirmatory evidence.
All probes are the Q1 linear probe (patch-mean features -> standardized ridge). The attentive probe is not used. Rollout latents are stored patch-mean pooled only.
Rollout latents are recomputed from the 002 checkpoints on this machine; 002's own latents were not stored. Differences to 002's stored numbers are in `reproduction`.

Condition (a) single_ind: its predictor was trained on ind episodes only. In C the probe is trained on a060/ind/a160 training rows, so for (a) two of three training sizes are rollouts of sizes the predictor never saw.
Seed-level intervals use n = 3 training seeds (df = 2); episode-bootstrap intervals cover evaluation-episode sampling only.
Untrained predictor: weights from torch.manual_seed(seed) + the hydra constructor of the trained class; the result depends on that initialisation. Two variants and 3 seeds are reported separately.

D properties: no proprio field exists (the dataset class returns zeros); gripper rows are commanded displacements (cumulative actions), not measured positions. Mask-derived properties depend on the HSV mask rule.
Persistence uses the context frame t = num_hist - 1 = 0, i.e. the first frame, because num_hist = 1.

F (teacher forcing): the teacher-forced latent uses the real encoder latent of the previous frame as context, including its real (encoded) proprio part; the open-loop rollout feeds back the predicted proprio part. The action part is the same action embedding in both. Step 1 is the same computation in both (the stored difference is reported).
Probe-seed variation of the linear probe is only through the GroupKFold split used to pick alpha; seeds listed in config.
note: No thresholds, pass/fail or p values are produced by this experiment. Synthetic selftest numbers are not results.
